notices.text:
Bun — the JavaScript runtime the Sovrium binary is compiled with (`bun build --compile`),
by Oven and the Bun contributors (https://github.com/oven-sh/bun). The compiled binary
contains the Bun runtime, so Bun's own license notice follows, verbatim from the Bun
repository at the version Sovrium pins (see `sovrium licenses` for that version).

Bun states that it is MIT-licensed without a copyright line of its own; the MIT terms are
reproduced after its notice. Bun statically links JavaScriptCore (LGPL-2) and the other
libraries listed below; the notice says how to obtain their source and relink.


-----------------------------------------------------------
Bun itself is MIT-licensed.

## JavaScriptCore

Bun statically links JavaScriptCore (and WebKit) which is LGPL-2 licensed. WebCore files from WebKit are also licensed under LGPL2. Per LGPL2:

> (1) If you statically link against an LGPL’d library, you must also provide your application in an object (not necessarily source) format, so that a user has the opportunity to modify the library and relink the application.

You can find the patched version of WebKit used by Bun here: <https://github.com/oven-sh/webkit>. If you would like to relink Bun with changes:

- `git clone https://github.com/oven-sh/WebKit vendor/WebKit`
- `bun sync-webkit-source` (checks out the version pinned in `WEBKIT_VERSION` in `scripts/build/deps/webkit.ts`)
- `bun run build:local`

This compiles JavaScriptCore, compiles Bun’s `.cpp` bindings for JavaScriptCore (which are the object files using JavaScriptCore) and outputs a new `bun` binary with your changes.
